title: SSTI in Bug Bounty Program: The Time I Played with Handlebars and Broke Stuff

scenario.summary: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) writeup.
preconditions: User input is embedded into a server-side template string before rendering, rather than passed as template data

process.action: Identify inputs that appear to be rendered through a template engine (personalized messages, PDF/report generation)
process.expected_observation: Candidate templated output identified

process.action: Inject a mathematical expression payload (e.g. ${7*7}, {{7*7}}) and check if it evaluates
process.expected_observation: Output shows '49' instead of the literal payload, confirming template evaluation

process.action: Fingerprint the specific template engine based on syntax that succeeds/fails
process.expected_observation: Engine identified (Jinja2, Twig, FreeMarker, etc.)

process.action: Escalate from expression evaluation to code execution using engine-specific gadget syntax
process.expected_observation: OS command execution achieved through the template engine's object model

impact: Remote code execution on the application server
Full disclosure of server-side application internals via template context objects
remediation: Never construct templates by concatenating user input; always pass user data as template variables, not template code
Use a sandboxed/logic-less template engine for any user-influenced rendering
Apply least-privilege execution for the rendering process
